name: Guangzhou Ruoyuchen Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Ruoyuchen Technology Co.,Ltd. provides e-commerce services to brand owners in China and internationally. It offers omnichannel operation, digital marketing, customer relationship management, live streaming service, recommendation via content creation, digitalization, visual design, channel distribution, customer service, and supply chain management services. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
